memories.title: SQLite storage boundary
memories.content: The storage module owns SQLite connections, migrations, transactions, and derived index persistence.

memories.title: Versioned schema upgrades
memories.content: All database changes are applied through ordered migrations and verified from every previously released schema.

memories.title: Native SQLite capability risk
memories.content: Node SQLite is experimental and sqlite-vec availability must be reported with deterministic fallback behavior.

memories.title: MCP protocol boundary
memories.content: The MCP module exposes repository-scoped tools over stdio and serializes tool results as protocol JSON only.

memories.title: Protocol-clean stdout
memories.content: MCP stdout must contain only JSON-RPC messages; diagnostics and warnings belong on stderr.

memories.title: CLI application boundary
memories.content: The CLI validates command input, delegates repository operations to RepositoryMemoryCore, and emits stable JSON when requested.

memories.title: Production build command
memories.content: Run npm run typecheck and npm run build before publishing a release.

memories.title: L2 narrative derivation
memories.content: Module narratives are independent derived records built only from active evidence-backed L1 memories.

memories.title: Traceable bounded conclusions
memories.content: Every rendered L2 conclusion retains its L1 Memory ID and the complete narrative stays inside its configured character budget.

memories.title: OpenCode host lifecycle
memories.content: The OpenCode integration starts retrieval before the Agent, captures execution evidence, and commits or abandons the session outside the model loop.

memories.title: Interrupted host run cleanup
memories.content: Timeouts, spawn failures, and interrupted Agent processes must not leave open RepoMind sessions or running host records.

memories.title: Rebuildable evaluation suites
memories.content: Evaluation code keeps task manifests, raw events, provenance, integrity gates, and paired reports separate from product storage.

memories.title: Default verification suite
memories.content: Run npm test to execute deterministic unit, integration, MCP, migration, and cross-process tests without a paid model.
